Container.Name: hermes-agent
Container.Overview:
Hermes Agent by Nous Research — self-hosted autonomous AI agent with persistent memory, multi-platform gateway (Matrix, Telegram, Discord, Slack, and more), MCP tool support, and self-improving skills. This image is the BitCryptic fork with Matrix E2EE fixes.
BEFORE STARTING: Create /mnt/cache/appdata/hermes/.hermes.env with your API keys. See https://github.com/bitcryptic-gw/hermes-agent for required configuration. Credentials must NOT be entered as container variables — they live in the .hermes.env file.

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Persistent storage for Hermes config, credentials, memory, and Matrix crypto store.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the container process runs as. Default 99 = nobody on Unraid.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the container process runs as. Default 100 = users on Unraid.

Config.Name: HERMES_HOME
Config.Description: Internal container path for Hermes data. Must match the container mount point. Do not change.

Config.Name: HERMES_LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Set to DEBUG for verbose logging (useful for Matrix E2EE troubleshooting). Leave blank for INFO.
